operations.name: read_serial_lsr
operations.desc: Read 16550 UART Line Status Register on COM1
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0x3FD
in al, dx
ret
operations.returns: LSR in AL (bit 0 = data ready, bit 5 = THR empty, bit 6 = transmitter idle)

operations.name: read_serial_msr
operations.desc: Read 16550 UART Modem Status Register on COM1
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0x3FE
in al, dx
ret
operations.returns: MSR in AL (bit 4 = CTS, bit 5 = DSR, bit 7 = DCD)
